chunks: They will call for every kind of fruit with satisfaction.
ai.seo_question: What do the believers call for in Paradise according to Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Amn' (security) not merely as physical safety but as freedom from anxiety and spiritual impurity, reflecting the perfected state of the faithful. The immediate responsiveness to their call signifies the direct link between divine will and human desire in Jannah, a theme often linked with the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate recipients of divine grace.
